about.title: About CVBoost
about.hero: Empowering job seekers across Cameroon with AI-driven tools to craft professional, tailored CVs that get results.
about.p1: Job hunting in Cameroon is tough. Generic CV templates don't capture local conventions, most tools are English-only, and professional CV services cost more than many job seekers can afford.
about.p2: CVBoost was built to change that. We combine AI technology with an understanding of both Francophone and Anglophone CV conventions to deliver tailored, ATS-friendly documents at a fraction of the cost.
about.p3: Whether you're applying to a multinational in Douala, a local startup in Yaoundé, or an international organization, CVBoost helps you present your experience in the best possible light.
about.value_honesty_desc: AI rewrites your real experience — never fabricates achievements, numbers, or skills you don't have.
about.value_inclusivity_desc: Full French and English support with CV conventions that respect local and international standards.
about.value_accessibility_desc: Affordable pricing designed for the Cameroonian market. Professional CV tools shouldn't break the bank.
about.cta_desc: Join hundreds of Cameroonian job seekers using AI to land more interviews.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_b: CVBoost ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our AI-powered CV tailoring platform. By using CVBoost, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
privacy.s21_l3: Password (stored as a bcrypt hash — we never store plain-text passwords)
privacy.s22_l1: CV text you upload or paste
privacy.s22_l2: CV content you build through our questionnaire
privacy.s22_l3: Job descriptions you submit for tailoring
privacy.s22_l4: AI-tailored CV output, cover letters, and gap analyses
privacy.s22_l5: Uploaded images of job postings (temporarily processed and not stored long-term)
privacy.s23_l4: Pages visited and actions taken within the Service
privacy.s24_b: Payment transactions are processed by CamPay (MTN Mobile Money / Orange Money). CVBoost does not store your mobile money PIN, full phone number, or any payment credentials on our servers. We only retain the transaction reference, amount, and status for account management purposes.
privacy.s3_l1_text: To process your CV content, run AI tailoring, and generate downloads.
privacy.s3_l2_text: To create and maintain your account, track subscriptions, and provide customer support.
privacy.s3_l3_text: To analyze anonymized usage patterns and improve the platform.
privacy.s3_l4_text: To detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access.
privacy.s3_l5_text: To send you important account-related emails (e.g., password resets, subscription confirmations). We do not send marketing emails without your explicit consent.
privacy.s4_b1: Your CV content is sent to our AI provider (Groq, running LLaMA 3.1) for processing when you use the tailoring feature. This data is processed in real-time and is not used to train AI models. Groq's API processes data in compliance with their privacy policy, and data in transit is encrypted via TLS.
privacy.s4_b2: We do not share your CV content with any third party for marketing, profiling, or any purpose other than providing the Service to you.
privacy.s5_l1: Your data is stored in MongoDB Atlas cloud databases with encryption at rest.
privacy.s5_l2: All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.3.
privacy.s5_l3: Authentication uses HTTP-only secure cookies with short-lived access tokens (15 minutes) and refresh tokens (7 days).
privacy.s5_l4: Passwords are hashed using bcrypt with 12 salt rounds.
privacy.s5_l5: We implement rate limiting, input sanitization, and security headers to protect against common attacks.
privacy.s5_l6: Access to production databases is restricted to authorized personnel only.
privacy.s6_l1_text: Retained as long as your account is active. Deleted within 30 days of account deletion.
privacy.s6_l2_text: Retained until you manually delete it from your dashboard or delete your account.
privacy.s6_l3_text: Retained for 5 years for legal and accounting compliance.
privacy.s6_l4_text: Anonymized after 30 days; fully purged after 90 days.
privacy.s6_l5_text: Processed in real-time and deleted immediately after text extraction.
privacy.s7_l1_text: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you.
privacy.s7_l2_text: Request correction of inaccurate personal data.
privacy.s7_l3_text: Request deletion of your personal data and account.
privacy.s7_l4_text: Request your data in a machine-readable format.
privacy.s7_l5_text: Opt out of any non-essential data processing at any time.
privacy.s7_contact_b: To exercise these rights, contact us at
privacy.s8_b: We use the following third-party services:
privacy.s8_b2: Each third-party service processes data in accordance with their own privacy policies. We encourage you to review their policies for more information.
privacy.s9_b: CVBoost uses essential HTTP-only cookies for authentication (access and refresh tokens). We do not use advertising cookies or third-party ad tracking. When enabled, we use privacy-respecting, self-hosted-style analytics (PostHog) that stores a random identifier in your browser's localStorage — never in cookies — solely to understand aggregate product usage. Your language and theme preferences are also stored in localStorage, not in cookies.
privacy.s10_b: CVBoost is not intended for users under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, we will take steps to delete it promptly.
privacy.s11_b: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email or a prominent notice on the Service. We encourage you to review this page periodically for the latest information.
privacy.s12_b: For questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at
